messages:
Maya (growth): Quick idea — Ember Sprint: run a very small PLG funnel experiment combining a short launch post + 30-min webinar invite + 25 free credits gated to registrants. Goal: move new signups to first successful generation within 48h.

Sam (content): Love it. What's the hypothesis? Higher webinar attendance -> higher 7-day activation than just credits?

Maya (growth): Exactly. H0: post-only credit drip has baseline activation 12%. H1: post + webinar + gated credits -> 20% activation. We also think prompt templates sent at T+0.5h increases conversion.

Ellie (ops): Operational ask: we need a distinct promo code per cohort and a simple redirect landing that captures cohort param. I can spin a landing if you give copy.

Maya (growth): Copy: "Ember Sprint — get 25 credits + a 30-min live walk-through. Limited seats." CTA: register -> get credits. Keep it short.

Sam (content): I'll draft post copy and 3 subject lines for the invite. Also create 4 short prompt templates for onboarding (email snippet, starter prompt for code, summary, meeting notes).

Noah (data): Can we define metrics + instrumentation? I'll need event names: signed_up, claimed_credit, attended_webinar, first_generation, activated_48h. Also cohort tag: ember_sprint_v1

Maya (growth): Yep. Activation = first_generation with tokens >= 20 within 48h. Capture UTM + cohort param.

growth-bot: Reminder: webinar seats set to 150, calendar created: https://cal.example/ember-sprint-03. Auto-reminder 24h & 1h.

Ellie (ops): Landing + codegen done. Promo codes: EMBER25-WEB and EMBER25-POST. Which cohorts mapped?

Maya (growth): EMBER25-WEB -> registrants who attend; EMBER25-POST -> organic post clickers. We want separate funnel attribution.

Sam (content): Drafts pushed to /drive/marketing/ember_sprint_copy.md. Preview in #marketing-review pls :eyes: 

Noah (data): Setting up a quick Looker dashboard: cohort funnels, activation rate, median time-to-first-generation, cost per activation (credits used). Will share link when ready.

Maya (growth): Quick timeline: copy + landing today, promo codes + tracking tomorrow, soft-launch post Thursday, webinar Friday. Minimal sample size target: 300 signups across both cohorts.

Ellie (ops): Noted. I'll do a smoke test of claim flow and redeem logic today at 16:00.

Sam (content): Need one-liner for Slack announcement. Suggest: "Ember Sprint — 25 credits + live walk-through — limited seats. Register now". Thoughts?

Maya (growth): Short + clear. go-ahead.

Noah (data): Ping me after soft-launch; I'll start capturing events.

Maya (growth): Thanks team — sync 15 after ops smoke test to confirm launch.
